common_rules.comparison_rows: exact identical canonical OOF keys, labels, costs, folds, horizon and top-k basis

ranking.scope: within UTC decision timestamp and side

common_rules.cost_unit: decimal net return per unit notional
common_rules.multiple_testing: all search arms and breadth must be reported; final replay is single-use

DEC-01.name: Pack-B closeness to shared-base historical comparator
DEC-01.failure_action: reject Pack-B replacement for that side

DEC-02.name: Residual-alpha improvement over matching Pack-B
DEC-02.failure_action: retain Pack-B alpha without residual expert for that side

DEC-03.name: CatBoost probability and hard-class collapse limits
DEC-03.failure_action: reject CatBoost arm irrespective of predictive loss

DEC-04.name: CatBoost combined model and economic objective
DEC-04.zscore: robust z-score across predeclared arms within each inner fold, clipped to [-3, 3], then mean across folds
DEC-04.tie_rule: select simplest unweighted arm unless challenger exceeds it by 0.10 objective units

DEC-05.name: Seven-class support policy
DEC-05.merge_policy: no post-hoc merge; immutable seven-class taxonomy
DEC-05.failure_action: CatBoost unavailable for failing side; run declared alpha-plus-auxiliary execution-EV arm

DEC-06.name: Execution-EV promotion uplift

confidence.method: paired ISO-week block bootstrap of challenger-minus-baseline deltas

DEC-06.promotion_scope: both long and short must independently pass

DEC-08.name: Common execution-EV unit and side-map equivalence
DEC-08.unit: decimal expected net return per unit notional from decision through canonical 12h policy exit
DEC-08.cost: 30bp round-trip fee plus full asset p90 spread, applied exactly once
DEC-08.mapping: independently fitted and calibrated by side
DEC-08.global_top10_use: reporting only until P1 global auction

DEC-09.name: Fold calendar, purge, embargo and untouched replay
DEC-09.train_authorization: decision_timestamp < validation_start AND label_end <= validation_start AND decision_timestamp <= validation_start - 24 hours
DEC-09.replay_use: single-use confirmation only; cannot alter models, maps, thresholds, policy settings or decision rules

DEC-10.name: Entry-timing validation and fallback
DEC-10.required_action_layer: separate deterministic tick-valid price policy with cost, liquidity, staleness, expiry and fill-feasibility gates
DEC-10.failure_action: retain enter_now; timing failure does not reject the stable execution-EV winner

required_manifest_bindings: label, entry, horizon and cost hashes
side-local OOF fold, cutoff and availability fields
